subdivision_of_building: Roof floor level and rear elevation
description: New Heating, ventilation and cooling equipment to be installed on the roof at the rear of the branch
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: normal;">Location Plan; Design and Access Statement; Noise Impact Assessment (20070-NIA-01-AA-R1) dated 5 June 2025; 50961245-MLA-FT-R1-M2-AR-7100; 50961245-MLA-FT-R1-M2-AR-7200; 50961245-DLL-CP-R1-M2-ML-2001 Rev P02; 50961245-DLL-CP-R1-M2-ML-2101 Rev P02; 50961245-DLL-CP-R1-M2-ML-2801 Rev P01; Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning; 50961245-DLL-CP-ZZ-M2-ML-2601 Rev P03; Dimensional Drawings; 50961245-MLA-FT-R1-M2-AR-7100.</span>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p><span style="line-height: normal;"><span style="height: 5.45pt;">The building services plant shall be installed , operated, and maintained in accordance with the approved Noise Impact Assessment 20070-NIA-01-AA-R15 dated in June 2025, and the following shall apply to safeguard the amenity of nearby occupies.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: normal;"><span style="height: 5.45pt;">a. If any noise-sensitive receptors are identified that are closer than those assessed in the submitted Noise Impact Assessment, the applicant shall submit an updated noise and vibration impact assessment in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 for approval by the Local Planning Authority prior to installation of any plant or implementation of associated mitigation.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: normal;"><span style="height: 5.45pt;"> b. The cumulative rating level of noise from all building services plant shall be at least 10 dB (A) below the representative background sound level ( LA90) at the façade of the nearest noise-sensitive premises, with appropriate corrections applied for tonal, impulsive, or intermittent characteristics, in line with BS4142:2014. </span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: normal;"><span style="height: 5.45pt;">c. The operation of any plant or equipment shall not result in preceptive vibration within the development or adjoining residential or noise-sensitive premises. </span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: normal;"><span style="height: 5.45pt;">d. No plant shall operate outside the hours of 08:00 to 18:00, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: normal;"><span style="height: 5.45pt;"> e. All plant shall be installed, operated, and maintained in accordance with the approved details, and any required mitigation shall be implemented prior to operation and retained for the lifetime of the development.&nbsp;</span></span></p>
